opening.argument: The presentation explains varicose veins through observable clinical detail: it describes skin changes and swelling, discusses ultrasound of the legs, and lists sclerotherapy, ablation, and vein stripping as treatment options. These are explanations of symptoms, evaluation, and procedures, consistent with the treatment-focused title. Professional identification and contact details are present, but the available evidence describes no deceptive offer, required payment flow, guaranteed outcome, or harmful transaction. The contact information does not, on its own, change the educational character of what is shown.
